headline: Water zones today — potato window closes Friday.
weather_notes: Run both zones today — 2 days since Aug 2 irrigation already exceeds the 1-day heat threshold at 91°F; delaying to Wednesday's 94°F or Thursday's 99°F compounds soil stress.
Do all outdoor work before 9 AM Wednesday and Thursday — 94°F Wednesday and 99°F Thursday with zero rain in the forecast close every afternoon window.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds through midday this week — 45-day transplants face sunscald risk at 91–99°F with 3+ weeks remaining before harvest.
Hand-water potato bags if dry between zone runs — containers lose moisture 2–3× faster than raised beds in sustained 90°F+ heat.

surfaced_tasks.title: Tip new blackberry primocanes if 3–4 ft tall
surfaced_tasks.reason: 25 days overdue — today's 91°F and Wednesday's 94°F are the week's only workable windows before Thursday's 99°F closes outdoor cane work.

suggested_tasks.title: Probe potato bags — 80-day window closes Friday
suggested_tasks.description: Yukon Gold at 77 days hits the end of its 65–80 day harvest window on Aug 7 — probe one bag Wednesday morning before Thursday's 99°F accelerates vine dieback.

suggested_tasks.title: Check w4 onions for soft necks and harvest
suggested_tasks.description: Super Star and Yellow Sweet Spanish at 101 days are in the 100–120 day maturity window — feel for soft necks and pull mature bulbs before the week's heat softens them further.

suggested_tasks.title: Harvest ripe blackberries before Thursday's 99°F
suggested_tasks.description: Jun 14 log confirmed berries forming and Triple Crown peaks mid-summer — Thursday's 99°F will bake any ripe fruit still on the cane.
